# from template(canon, @mgm_pease_porridge_hot, subject=<[d5 c#5] [b4 a4] [b4 c#5]>): a canon at 90 in D, the phrase sung over it (templates v1)
# phrase: @mgm_pease_porridge_hot, "Pease Porridge hot, / Pease Porridge cold," ('Pease Porridge hot' (riddle: 'Spell me that in four Letters? I will. T-H-A-T.'), Anonymous, 1780)
# vocal: 8 syllables, free, straight feel, stress xx~xxx~x: a vocal line of 2 bars, sung over sections of 8 bars
# subject: <[d5 c#5] [b4 a4] [b4 c#5]>; the line chased by copies of itself, a bar and a beat behind
# ground: Pachelbel's ground, pachelbel_ground; the bass under the chase
tempo 90
key d

# the drums: the drm_* parts are what the arrangement changes; the kick and the shaker stay put
let kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~
let drm_rim = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~
let shk = x ~ x x ~ x x ~
let pachelbel_ground_1 = d3 ~ ~ ~ a2 ~ ~ ~ b2 ~ ~ ~ f#2 ~ ~ ~
let pachelbel_ground_2 = g2 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~ g2 ~ ~ ~ a2 ~ ~ ~
let pachelbel_ground = <pachelbel_ground_1 pachelbel_ground_2>
# subject, bound: <[d5 c#5] [b4 a4] [b4 c#5]>
let subject_1 = d5 c#5
let subject_2 = b4 a4
let subject_3 = b4 c#5
let subject = <subject_1 subject_2 subject_3>
# the copies: a bar behind, and a beat behind; they are made of the theme's own bars, so a change to it moves them too
let follow = <subject_3 subject_1 subject_2>
let close = rotate(subject, 4)
# the vocal line: a degree of the key for each syllable, ! on the stressed ones
let vox_a = 1! ~ 1! 2 3! ~ 3! ~
let vox_b = 5! 6 8! ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

# lead: the theme alone over the ground
section lead 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | bass pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: melody subject inst=flute vel=60..80
}

# chase: the copy a bar behind, an octave down
section chase 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=70..84 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=36..54 | bass pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=60..74
  deck B: melody subject inst=flute vel=52..70 | arp octave(follow, -1) inst=harpsichord vel=40..56
}

# round: three voices, the last a beat behind the first
section round 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=72..86 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..58 | snare drm_rim kit=drums-lofi vel=26..44 | bass pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=60..74
  deck B: melody subject inst=flute vel=50..68 | arp octave(follow, -1) inst=harpsichord vel=38..55 | harmony close inst=strings vel=32..45
}

# sung: the phrase over the ground, the copies buried
section sung 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | hihat shk kit=drums vel=30..45 | bass pachelbel_ground inst=bass vel=65..80 | arp octave(follow, -1) inst=harpsichord vel=25..40
  deck B: harmony close inst=strings vel=25..40 | melody <vox_a vox_b> inst=kalimba oct=3 vel=24..38
  deck B: sing "/p ee z - p aw r ii j - h aa t/ / /p ee z - p aw r ii j - k oh l d/" on melody voice=robot-choir
}

# the theme chases itself: whatever is done to it, its copies follow
arrange {
  lead
  chase
  ~ subject_* rot 2
  round
  ~ drm_* grow
  sung
  ~ subject_* rev | accent 0.25
  round
  @ vox_* xfer shk
  sung
  ~ subject_* rev
  ~ drm_* decay
} loop 3 then end
